name: Empire of Vietnam (1945)
description: A yellow field with three horizontal red bars, the middle bar broken — the quẻ Ly trigram.
history: Flag of the Empire of Vietnam, the Japanese-sponsored state under Bảo Đại (March–August 1945); its Ly trigram evolved into the three full stripes of the later State of Vietnam.

features.role: quẻ Ly trigram — three bars, the centre one broken
features.symbolism: the I Ching trigram for fire and the south
